jobs.title: Sales Manager
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR114219 The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation. MAISON OVERVIEW At Cartier, you will be part of a community bound by a strong sense of responsibility, where connection, collaboration, and collective spirit thrive. We empower individual talents, united by a shared commitment to excellence, inspired by the world's diverse cultures, to respect and enrich our unique heritage. We believe that different perspectives fuel innovation and drive us to create exceptional experiences. 
• We offer an energizing environment for career growth and the opportunity to contribute your individual vision to a legacy of creativity. We celebrate every achievement, big or small, fostering meaningful connections through gratitude and mutual support, nurturing a sense of belonging. Join us at Cartier, a place like no other, forever moving forward. MISSION & RESPONSIBILITIES The Sales Manager drives the performance, engagement, and development of the boutique’s sales team, ensuring that every client interaction reflects the Maison’s values of excellence, generosity, and curiosity. As a true people leader and business driver, the Sales Manager translates Cartier’s strategy into daily action — inspiring the team, maximizing performance, and delivering an exceptional client experience that embodies the spirit of the Maison. Animate performance and lead from the floor Set, monitor, and track individual and collective sales KPIs to ensure performance targets are met. Lead daily and weekly business rituals (briefings, follow-ups, one-to-one sessions) with energy, focus, and clarity. Ensure excellence in client experience and retail operations, guaranteeing compliance and alignment with Maison standards. Act as a floor leader, maintaining a visible and inspiring presence on the sales floor to drive engagement, support teams, and ensure real-time coaching. Provide active feedback and guidance during client interactions to enhance sales impact and storytelling. Collaborate closely with the Boutique Manager and Operations Manager to ensure flawless boutique performance and team coordination. Develop and elevate the team Conduct individual performance reviews, providing regular feedback, coaching, and development opportunities. Build and implement individual development plans (IDPs) and performance management plans (PMPs) tailored to each Sales Associate. Identify and nurture talents, ensuring strong succession planning within the team. Reinforce Cartier’s service culture by anchoring the Chez Cartier standards of excellence in all client interactions. Lead by example, promoting a learning mindset and fostering continuous improvement. Encourage collaboration, motivation, and collective success through clear communication and recognition. Develop client portfolios and cultivate long-term client relationships Monitor and analyze client satisfaction data (CER, FTR, CARE) to drive performance and elevate the client experience. Support Sales Associates in developing and managing their client portfolios with a focus on loyalty and retention. Supervise clienteling action plans and ensure personalized outreach aligned with each client’s profile and preferences. Lead follow-up actions to strengthen High Jewelry and VIC client relationships, ensuring bespoke service and attention. Promote excellence in hosting and client experience within the boutique. Partner with the Client/CRM Manager to identify opportunities for growth and cross-selling. Maison Ambassadorship Act as an ambassador of Cartier in the local community, embodying the Maison’s values with elegance and confidence. Strengthen partnerships and build relationships that enhance the boutique’s visibility and reputation. Participate in local events and initiatives that align with the Maison’s image and spirit. PROFILE Proven managerial experience in a dynamic retail or luxury environment. Strong commercial and leadership acumen, capable of inspiring and developing high-performing teams. Deep understanding of luxury client expectations and the art of relationship-building. Hands-on leader with strong presence on the floor, leading by example and driving team motivation. Excellent communication, coaching, and problem-solving skills. Minimum of 5+ years of professional experience in retail industry . SKILLS Mastery of sales management and retail KPIs, ensuring performance and strategic alignment. Strong floor leadership and the ability to engage teams in real time to drive results. Proven experience in client engagement, with an understanding of data-driven decision-making. Excellent organizational and analytical abilities to monitor performance and optimize sales processes. Solid business acumen to translate boutique goals into actionable initiatives. Inspirational leadership that combines empathy, confidence, and assertiveness. Exceptional communication and coaching abilities, fostering trust and empowerment within the team. Entrepreneurial mindset with curiosity and adaptability to changing environments. Client-centric approach grounded in generosity, authenticity, and excellence. Team spirit and collaborative attitude to drive collective success. descriptionByLocale.it: Codice di riferimento: JR114219 La storia di Cartier è fondata su curiosità e passione. Da oltre 170 anni abbiamo abbracciato uno spirito coraggioso e pionieristico che continua a ispirare i nostri team di tutti i Métiers dalle nostre boutique ai nostri laboratori e uffici aziendali. I nostri 10.000+ colleghi di oltre 105 nazionalità sono uniti da uno spirito indipendente condiviso e dall’impegno per l’eccellenza, cercando di arricchire continuamente il patrimonio della Maison spingendo i confini della creatività e dell’innovazione. MAISON OverVIEW A Cartier, sarete parte di una comunità legata da un forte senso di responsabilità, dove la connessione, la collaborazione e lo spirito collettivo prosperano. Potenziamo i singoli talenti, uniti da un impegno condiviso per l'eccellenza, ispirato alle diverse culture del mondo, per rispettare e arricchire il nostro patrimonio unico. Crediamo che diverse prospettive alimentano l'innovazione e ci spingono a creare esperienze eccezionali. • Offriamo un ambiente energizzante per la crescita della carriera e l'opportunità di contribuire la vostra visione individuale a un'eredità di creatività. Celebriamo ogni risultato, grande o piccolo, promuovendo connessioni significative attraverso la gratitudine e il sostegno reciproco, alimentando un senso di appartenenza. Unisciti a noi a Cartier, un posto come nessun altro, per sempre andare avanti. MISSION & RESPONSABILITÀ Il Sales Manager guida le prestazioni, il coinvolgimento e lo sviluppo del team di vendita della boutique, assicurando che ogni interazione cliente rifletta i valori di eccellenza, generosità e curiosità della Maison. In qualità di vero leader e business driver, il Sales Manager traduce la strategia di Cartier in azione quotidiana — ispirando il team, massimizzando le prestazioni e offrendo un'esperienza cliente eccezionale che incarna lo spirito della Maison. Animare le prestazioni e il piombo dal pavimento Set, monitor e monitorare i KPI di vendita individuali e collettivi per garantire obiettivi di prestazioni sono soddisfatti. Guidare rituali aziendali giornalieri e settimanali (briefing, follow-up, sessioni one-to-one) con energia, fuoco e chiarezza. Garantire l'eccellenza nell'esperienza dei clienti e nelle operazioni di vendita al dettaglio, garantendo la conformità e l'allineamento con gli standard Maison. Agire come leader del pavimento, mantenere una presenza visibile e stimolante sul piano di vendita per guidare il fidanzamento, le squadre di supporto, e garantire in tempo reale coaching. Fornisci feedback attivo e guida durante le interazioni dei clienti per migliorare l'impatto delle vendite e lo storytelling. Collabora a stretto contatto con il Boutique Manager e il Operations Manager per garantire prestazioni boutique e coordinamento team impeccabile. Sviluppare ed elevare il team Condurre recensioni di prestazioni individuali, fornendo feedback regolari, coaching e opportunità di sviluppo. Costruire e implementare piani di sviluppo individuali (IDP) e piani di gestione delle prestazioni (PMP) su misura per ogni Sales Associate. Identificare e nutrire i talenti, garantendo una forte pianificazione di successione all'interno del team. Rinforzare la cultura di servizio di Cartier ancorando gli standard di eccellenza Chez Cartier in tutte le interazioni dei clienti. Guidare per esempio, promuovere una mentalità di apprendimento e promuovere il miglioramento continuo. Incoraggia la collaborazione, la motivazione e il successo collettivo attraverso una comunicazione chiara e un riconoscimento. Sviluppa portafogli client e coltiva relazioni client a lungo termine Monitora e analizza i dati di soddisfazione del cliente (CER, FTR, CARE) per guidare le prestazioni e aumentare l'esperienza del cliente. Sostegno Vendite Associati nello sviluppo e nella gestione dei loro portafogli clienti con un focus sulla fedeltà e la ritenzione. Superare i piani d'azione della clientela e garantire un outreach personalizzato allineato con il profilo e le preferenze di ogni cliente. Condurre azioni di follow-up per rafforzare le relazioni con i clienti High Jewelry e VIC, assicurando servizio e attenzione su misura. Promuovere l'eccellenza nell'accoglienza e l'esperienza dei clienti all'interno della boutique. Partner con il Client/CRM Manager per identificare le opportunità di crescita e cross-selling. Ambasciatore di Maison Agire come ambasciatore di Cartier nella comunità locale, incarnando i valori della Maison con eleganza e fiducia. Rafforzare le partnership e costruire relazioni che valorizzano la visibilità e la reputazione della boutique. Partecipa a eventi e iniziative locali che si allineano con l’immagine e lo spirito della Maison. PROFESSIONALE Provata esperienza manageriale in un ambiente dinamico di vendita al dettaglio o lusso. Forte acume commerciale e di leadership, capace di ispirare e sviluppare squadre ad alto rendimento. Profonda comprensione delle aspettative dei clienti di lusso e l'arte della costruzione di relazioni. Leader Hands-on con forte presenza sul pavimento, leader per esempio e motivazione del team di guida. Ottima comunicazione, coaching e capacità di problem solving. Minimo 5+ anni di esperienza professionale nel settore retail . SKILLS Mastery di gestione delle vendite e KPI retail, garantendo prestazioni e allineamento strategico. Forte leadership del pavimento e la capacità di coinvolgere le squadre in tempo reale per guidare i risultati. Provata esperienza nell'impegno del cliente, con una comprensione del processo decisionale basato sui dati. Eccellente capacità organizzative e analitiche per monitorare le prestazioni e ottimizzare i processi di vendita. Solid business acum per tradurre gli obiettivi boutique in iniziative attuabili. Leadership inspirativa che combina empatia, fiducia e assertività. Eccezionale capacità di comunicazione e coaching, favorendo la fiducia e l'empowerment all'interno della squadra. Mindset Entrepreneurial con curiosità e adattabilità agli ambienti mutevoli. L'approccio client-centrico basato sulla generosità, l'autenticità e l'eccellenza. Spirito di squadra e atteggiamento collaborativo per guidare il successo collettivo. Simili lavori SENIOR SALES ASSOCIATE Save Bangkok, Thailandia Cartier ASSISTANT BOUTIQUE MANAGER Save Macau, Macau SAR, Cina Cartier SALES MANAGER- CITY CENTER Save Las Vegas, Stati Uniti d'America Cartier

descriptionByLocale.de: Bezugscode: JR114219 Die Geschichte von Cartier basiert auf Neugier und Leidenschaft. Seit mehr als 170 Jahren haben wir einen mutigen Pioniergeist, der unsere Teams in allen Métiers von unseren Boutiquen bis zu unseren Werkstätten und Firmenbüros inspiriert. Unsere mehr als 10.000 Kollegen aus mehr als 105 Nationalitäten sind durch einen gemeinsamen unabhängigen Geist und Engagement für Exzellenz vereint und streben danach, das Erbe unseres Hauses kontinuierlich zu bereichern, indem wir die Grenzen von Kreativität und Innovation überschreiten. MAISONENÜBERPRÜFUNG Bei Cartier werden Sie Teil einer Gemeinschaft sein, die durch ein starkes Verantwortungsbewusstsein verbunden ist, in der Verbindung, Zusammenarbeit und kollektiver Geist gedeihen. Wir befähigen individuelle Talente, vereint durch ein gemeinsames Engagement für Exzellenz, inspiriert von den vielfältigen Kulturen der Welt, unser einzigartiges Erbe zu respektieren und zu bereichern. Wir glauben, dass unterschiedliche Perspektiven Innovationen fördern und uns dazu bringen, außergewöhnliche Erlebnisse zu schaffen. • Wir bieten ein anregendes Umfeld für berufliches Wachstum und die Möglichkeit, Ihre individuelle Vision zu einem Vermächtnis der Kreativität beizutragen. Wir feiern jede Leistung, ob groß oder klein, fördern sinnvolle Verbindungen durch Dankbarkeit und gegenseitige Unterstützung und fördern ein Gefühl der Zugehörigkeit. Begleiten Sie uns bei Cartier, einem Ort wie kein anderer, der für immer voranschreitet. AUFTRAG UND ZUSTÄNDIGKEITEN Der Sales Manager treibt die Leistung, das Engagement und die Entwicklung des Verkaufsteams der Boutique voran und stellt sicher, dass jede Kundeninteraktion die Werte der Maison von Exzellenz, Großzügigkeit und Neugier widerspiegelt. Als echter People Leader und Business Driver übersetzt der Sales Manager die Strategie von Cartier in tägliches Handeln - inspiriert das Team, maximiert die Leistung und bietet eine außergewöhnliche Kundenerfahrung, die den Geist der Maison verkörpert. Performance animieren und von der Etage aus führen Setzen, überwachen und verfolgen Sie individuelle und kollektive Verkaufs-KPIs, um sicherzustellen, dass die Leistungsziele erreicht werden. Führen Sie tägliche und wöchentliche Geschäftsrituale (Briefings, Follow-ups, Einzelsitzungen) mit Energie, Fokus und Klarheit. Stellen Sie Exzellenz in der Kundenerfahrung und im Einzelhandel sicher und garantieren Sie die Einhaltung und Übereinstimmung mit den Maison-Standards. Handeln Sie als Floor Leader und halten Sie eine sichtbare und inspirierende Präsenz in der Verkaufshalle, um Engagement zu fördern, Teams zu unterstützen und Echtzeit-Coaching zu gewährleisten. Aktives Feedback und Anleitung während der Kundeninteraktionen, um die Verkaufswirkung und das Storytelling zu verbessern. Arbeiten Sie eng mit dem Boutique Manager und dem Operations Manager zusammen, um eine einwandfreie Boutique-Leistung und Teamkoordination zu gewährleisten. Entwickeln und erhöhen Sie das Team Führen Sie individuelle Leistungsüberprüfungen durch und bieten Sie regelmäßiges Feedback, Coaching und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Erstellen und implementieren Sie individuelle Entwicklungspläne (IDPs) und Leistungsmanagementpläne (PMPs), die auf jeden Vertriebsmitarbeiter zugeschnitten sind. Identifizieren und fördern Sie Talente und sorgen Sie für eine starke Nachfolgeplanung im Team. Stärkung der Servicekultur von Cartier durch die Verankerung der Exzellenzstandards von Chez Cartier in allen Kundeninteraktionen. Mit gutem Beispiel vorangehen, eine Lernmentalität fördern und kontinuierliche Verbesserung fördern. Förderung von Zusammenarbeit, Motivation und kollektivem Erfolg durch klare Kommunikation und Anerkennung. Kundenportfolios entwickeln und langfristige Kundenbeziehungen pflegen Überwachen und analysieren Sie Kundenzufriedenheitsdaten (CER, FTR, CARE), um die Leistung zu steigern und die Kundenerfahrung zu verbessern. Unterstützen Sie Vertriebsmitarbeiter bei der Entwicklung und Verwaltung ihrer Kundenportfolios mit Fokus auf Loyalität und Bindung. Beaufsichtigen Sie die Aktionspläne der Kunden und stellen Sie eine personalisierte Öffentlichkeitsarbeit sicher, die auf das Profil und die Präferenzen jedes Kunden abgestimmt ist. Führen Sie Folgemaßnahmen zur Stärkung der Kundenbeziehungen zwischen High Jewelry und VIC, um maßgeschneiderten Service und Aufmerksamkeit zu gewährleisten. Fördern Sie Exzellenz in Hosting und Kundenerfahrung in der Boutique. Partnerschaft mit dem Client/CRM-Manager, um Wachstumsmöglichkeiten und Cross-Selling zu identifizieren. Maison Ambassadoring Handeln Sie als Botschafter von Cartier in der lokalen Gemeinschaft und verkörpern Sie die Werte des Hauses mit Eleganz und Zuversicht. Stärken Sie Partnerschaften und bauen Sie Beziehungen auf, die die Sichtbarkeit und den Ruf der Boutique verbessern. Nehmen Sie an lokalen Veranstaltungen und Initiativen teil, die mit dem Image und dem Geist der Maison in Einklang stehen. PROFIL Bewährte Managementerfahrung in einem dynamischen Einzelhandels- oder Luxusumfeld. Starker Geschäfts- und Führungssinn, der in der Lage ist, leistungsstarke Teams zu inspirieren und zu entwickeln. Tiefes Verständnis der Luxus-Kundenerwartungen und der Kunst des Beziehungsaufbaus. Hands-on-Führer mit starker Präsenz auf dem Boden, mit gutem Beispiel vorangehend und Teammotivation. Hervorragende Kommunikation, Coaching und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten. Mindestens 5+ Jahre Berufserfahrung im Einzelhandel. FÄHLE Beherrschung von Sales Management und Retail KPIs, Sicherstellung von Performance und strategischer Ausrichtung. Starke Bodenführung und die Fähigkeit, Teams in Echtzeit einzubinden, um Ergebnisse zu erzielen. Nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Kundenengagement mit einem Verständnis der datengesteuerten Entscheidungsfindung. Hervorragende organisatorische und analytische Fähigkeiten zur Leistungsüberwachung und Optimierung von Verkaufsprozessen. Solider Geschäftssinn, um Boutique-Ziele in umsetzbare Initiativen zu übersetzen. Inspirierende Führung, die Empathie, Selbstvertrauen und Durchsetzungsvermögen kombiniert. Außergewöhnliche Kommunikation und Coaching-Fähigkeiten, die Vertrauen und Empowerment innerhalb des Teams fördern. Unternehmerische Denkweise mit Neugier und Anpassungsfähigkeit an sich verändernde Umgebungen. Kundenorientierter Ansatz basiert auf Großzügigkeit, Authentizität und Exzellenz. Teamgeist und kooperative Einstellung, um den kollektiven Erfolg voranzutreiben. descriptionByLocale.fr: Code de référence: JR114219 L'histoire de Cartier est fondée sur la curiosité et la passion. Depuis plus de 170 ans, nous avons adopté un esprit audacieux et pionnier qui continue d'inspirer nos équipes de tous les Métiers, de nos boutiques à nos ateliers et bureaux corporatifs. Nos plus de 10 000 collègues de plus de 105 nationalités sont unis par un esprit indépendant partagé et un engagement en faveur de l'excellence, s'efforçant d'enrichir continuellement notre patrimoine de Maison en repoussant les frontières de la créativité et de l'innovation. APERÇU DE MAISON Chez Cartier, vous ferez partie d'une communauté liée par un fort sens des responsabilités, où la connexion, la collaboration et l'esprit collectif prospèrent. Nous autonomisons les talents individuels, unis par un engagement commun en faveur de l'excellence, inspiré par les diverses cultures du monde, pour respecter et enrichir notre patrimoine unique. Nous croyons que différentes perspectives alimentent l'innovation et nous poussent à créer des expériences exceptionnelles. • Nous offrons un environnement stimulant pour la croissance de carrière et la possibilité de contribuer à votre vision individuelle à un héritage de créativité. Nous célébrons toutes les réalisations, grandes ou petites, favorisant des relations significatives par la gratitude et le soutien mutuel, nourrissant un sentiment d'appartenance. Rejoignez-nous à Cartier, un endroit comme personne d'autre, toujours aller de l'avant. MISSION ET RESPONSABILITÉS Le responsable des ventes anime la performance, l'engagement et le développement de l'équipe de vente de la boutique, assurant que chaque interaction client reflète les valeurs d'excellence, de générosité et de curiosité de la Maison. Véritable chef de file et conducteur d'entreprise, le directeur des ventes traduit la stratégie Cartier en action quotidienne – inspirant l'équipe, maximisant les performances et offrant une expérience client exceptionnelle qui incarne l'esprit de la Maison. Performances animées et plomb à partir du jeu de planchers, surveiller et suivre les KPI de ventes individuelles et collectives pour s'assurer que les objectifs de rendement sont atteints. Diriger les rituels d'affaires quotidiens et hebdomadaires (briefings, suivis, séances individuelles) avec énergie, concentration et clarté. Assurer l'excellence dans l'expérience client et les opérations de détail, en garantissant la conformité et l'alignement avec les normes de Maison. Agir en tant que leader de plancher, maintenir une présence visible et inspirante sur le plancher des ventes pour conduire l'engagement, soutenir les équipes, et assurer un coaching en temps réel. Fournir une rétroaction active et des conseils pendant les interactions avec les clients afin d'améliorer l'impact des ventes et la narration. Collaborer étroitement avec le directeur de la boutique et le directeur des opérations pour assurer une performance impeccable et la coordination de l'équipe. Élaborer et élever l'équipe Effectuer des examens de rendement individuels, en fournissant régulièrement des commentaires, des services d'encadrement et des occasions de perfectionnement. Élaborer et mettre en oeuvre des plans de développement individuels (PDI) et des plans de gestion du rendement (PGR) adaptés à chaque associé commercial. Identifier et entretenir les talents, en assurant une solide planification de la relève au sein de l'équipe. Renforcer la culture de service de Cartier en ancrer les normes d'excellence Chez Cartier dans toutes les interactions client. Diriger par l'exemple, promouvoir une mentalité d'apprentissage et favoriser l'amélioration continue. Encourager la collaboration, la motivation et la réussite collective par une communication et une reconnaissance claires. Développer les portefeuilles de clients et cultiver des relations client à long terme Surveiller et analyser les données sur la satisfaction de la clientèle (CER, FTR, CARE) pour stimuler le rendement et améliorer l'expérience client. Soutenir les associés commerciaux dans le développement et la gestion de leurs portefeuilles clients en mettant l'accent sur la loyauté et le maintien en poste. Superviser les plans d'action clients et veiller à ce que la portée personnalisée soit alignée sur le profil et les préférences de chaque client. Diriger des actions de suivi pour renforcer les relations clientes High Bijoux et CIV, en assurant un service et une attention sur mesure. Promouvoir l'excellence dans l'hébergement et l'expérience client au sein de la boutique. Établir un partenariat avec le gestionnaire client/CRM pour cerner les possibilités de croissance et de vente croisée. Maison Ambassadrice Agir comme ambassadeur de Cartier dans la communauté locale, incarner les valeurs de la Maison avec élégance et confiance. Renforcer les partenariats et établir des relations qui améliorent la visibilité et la réputation de la boutique. Participer à des événements et des initiatives locaux qui s'harmonisent avec l'image et l'esprit de la Maison. PROFIL Expérience de gestion éprouvée dans un environnement de détail ou de luxe dynamique. Forte activité commerciale et de leadership, capable d'inspirer et de développer des équipes performantes. Compréhension approfondie des attentes des clients de luxe et de l'art de l'établissement de relations. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. HOW WILL YOU MAKE A DIFFERENCE? WIE MACHEN SIE EINEN UNTERSCHIED? Im Mittelpunkt der Aktivitäten unseres Villars-sur-Glâne-Campus sind Sie an der Führung der Konten unserer Unternehmen beteiligt. Karriereweg und berufliche Fähigkeiten • Sie sind Absolvent einer Business School (EC) oder eines gleichwertigen Abschlusses und suchen ein 12-monatiges Praktikum, das Ihnen den Zugang zu einem HEG ermöglicht • Sie sind mit Zahlen vertraut • Sie sprechen fließend Französisch und verfügen idealerweise über gute Englischkenntnisse. Persönliche Fähigkeiten • Genauigkeit und Sinn für Präzision • Neugier und Lerndurst • Analytisches Denken • Organisationstalent und Prioritätenmanagement Sozialkompetenz • Teamgeist • Dynamische und gute Kommunikation WAS UNTERSCHEIDET UNSERE GRUPPE? Unsere wahre Stärke liegt nicht in unseren Gemeinsamkeiten, sondern in der reichen Vielfalt unserer Künste, Kulturen und menschlichen Fähigkeiten sowie in unserer besonderen Fähigkeit, ungenutztes Potenzial zu fördern. • Wir legen Wert auf Freiheit, Kollegialität, Loyalität und Solidarität. • Wir fördern Empathie, Neugier, Mut, Bescheidenheit und Integrität. • Wir kümmern uns um die Welt, in der wir leben. IHRE KANDIDATEN-ERFAHRUNG MIT UNS Wenn Ihre Bewerbung ausgewählt wird, wird sich unser HR-Team schnell für ein erstes Sondierungsgespräch mit Ihnen in Verbindung setzen. Der nächste Schritt wird ein persönliches Gespräch mit dem Manager und den Teammitgliedern sein. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Ähnliche Jobs HSE-Spezialist Save Villars Sur Glâne, Schweiz Richemont Praktikant Archivar Save Le Sentier, Schweiz Jaeger-LeCoultre Bestätigter Polierer M/W Save Paris, Frankreich Richemont

jobs.description: Reference code: JR122752 Since 1833, driven by an unquenchable thirst for innovation and creativity, and inspired by the peaceful natural surroundings of its home in the Vallée de Joux, Jaeger-LeCoultre has been distinguished by its mastery of complications and the precision of its mechanisms. Known as the Watchmaker of Watchmakers, the Manufacture has expressed its relentlessly inventive spirit through the creation of more than 1,400 different calibres and the award of more than 430 patents. Harnessing 190 years of accumulated expertise, La Grande Maison’s watchmakers design, produce, finish and ornament the most advanced and precise mechanisms, blending passion with centuries-old savoir-faire, linking the past to the future, timeless but always up with the times. With 180 skills brought together under one roof, the Manufacture creates fine timepieces that combine technical ingenuity with aesthetic beauty and a distinctively understated sophistication. VOTRE MISSION : Presser et fixer des diamants et autres pierres précieuses sur des bijoux, des objets, des composants de montres ou des lunettes, conformément aux exigences de qualité, de délai et de sécurité. COMMENT AUREZ-VOUS UN IMPACT ? Sur la production : Réaliser des opérations de sertissage sur les composants horlogers et joaillers Utiliser des techniques manuelles de sertissage : grain, traditionnel, baguette, clos, griffe, invisible S’assurer de la conformité et de la qualité des pièces livrées Sur les nouveautés : Travailler sur des petites séries Participer à l’industrialisation des nouveaux produits Sur l’atelier : Travailler en équipe avec les autres métiers artisans de l’atelier Être force de proposition d’amélioration LA CLÉ DE VOTRE SUCCÈS ? VOS COMPÉTENCES ! Expérience dans le domaine du sertissage indispensable, idéalement dans un milieu horloger, avec de préférence entre 3-5 ans de pratique, Une formation en bijouterie, est un plus. Vous êtes passionné et vous faites preuve d’exigence, de minutie et de précision dans votre travail. Vous aimez travailler en équipe et avez de bonnes capacités de communication. Vous êtes ouvert à la participation d’évènements pour la présentation du métier. jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Reference code: JR123788 The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation. “Join us to unleash the power of #data, leverage our cloud platforms and deploy at scale state-of-the-art initiatives! You will be part of a young, dynamic and talented team working on analytics and artificial intelligence with real-life, impactful business applications.” — Thomas M.; Data Officer As a Data Engineer, you’ll be responsible for building and maintaining the data and BI infrastructure that powers our analytics and ML initiatives. You’ll design scalable data pipelines, ensure data quality, enable self-service analytic capabilities and build BI products across the organization. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT ? "The data engineer sits at the foundation of the data stack, ensuring that every insight in Looker is powered by a robust, scalable, and governed pipeline." Navigating between technical infrastructure and business intelligence, you will have the opportunity to design the data models that drive business decisions across the Maison. YOUR MAIN MISSIONS Within the Cartier Data Office, you will build business-ready data models, high-performance infrastructure, and large-scale reporting dashboards. Analytics Capabilities with Looker: You will configure and maintain Looker dashboards and explores, translating complex business questions into actionable insights. You will train "viewers" and "explorers" on how to get the most out of the platform. Data Modeling & Transformation: You will design and implement dbt models and dimensional data marts, applying software engineering best practices (version control, testing) to the analytics layer. Pipeline Engineering: You will build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines using Airflow/Apache Composer, ensuring seamless data ingestion into BigQuery. Platform Operations: You will monitor data platform health, troubleshoot quality issues, and implement data governance and access controls. Documentation: You will maintain data definitions and lineage, ensuring Looker remains a "single source of truth" for the organization. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US ? You have a Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related scientific field and 3-5 years of experience in data engineering or analytics engineering. You have a strong proficiency in Looker (LookML) or PowerBI, and SQL/DBT. You know how to build sophisticated dashboards and the transformation layers that power them. You have a deep understanding of Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery) and are expert in SQL and Python. You have experience building pipelines with Airflow/Apache Composer. You like to work in a fast-paced environment, quickly delivering new features for demanding business users using an Agile/DevOps operating model. HOW DO WE KEEP YOU SMILING ? In a young and dynamic team focused on personal development, you will take part in Cartier’s data journey, leveraging state-of-the-art tool. You will work with multicultural stakeholders from different business units for a leading Company in the luxury industry. You will have the opportunity to mentor team members as our data maturity grows. descriptionByLocale.it: Codice di riferimento: JR123788 La storia di Cartier si fonda sulla curiosità e sulla passione. Da oltre 170 anni abbracciamo uno spirito audace e pionieristico che continua a ispirare i nostri team in tutti i settori, dalle boutique ai laboratori e agli uffici aziendali. I nostri oltre 10.000 colleghi di oltre 105 nazionalità sono uniti da uno spirito indipendente condiviso e da un impegno per l’eccellenza, sforzandosi di arricchire continuamente il patrimonio della nostra Maison spingendo i confini della creatività e dell’innovazione. "Unisciti a noi per liberare la potenza dei #dati, sfruttare le nostre piattaforme cloud e implementare iniziative all'avanguardia su larga scala! Farai parte di un team giovane, dinamico e di talento che lavora sull'analisi e sull'intelligenza artificiale con applicazioni aziendali reali e di grande impatto." — Tommaso M.; Data Officer In qualità di Data Engineer, sarai responsabile della creazione e della manutenzione dell'infrastruttura di dati e BI che alimenta le nostre iniziative di analisi e ML. Progetterai pipeline di dati scalabili, garantirai la qualità dei dati, abiliterai funzionalità analitiche self-service e creerai prodotti BI in tutta l'organizzazione. COME AVRAI UN IMPATTO? "Il data engineer è alla base dello stack di dati, garantendo che ogni insight in Looker sia alimentato da una pipeline solida, scalabile e governata." Navigando tra l'infrastruttura tecnica e la business intelligence, avrai l'opportunità di progettare i modelli di dati che guidano le decisioni aziendali in tutta la Maison. LE TUE MISSIONI PRINCIPALI All'interno di Cartier Data Office, creerai modelli di dati pronti per il business, infrastrutture ad alte prestazioni e dashboard di reporting su larga scala. Funzionalità di analisi con Looker: configurerai e manterrai dashboard ed esplorazioni di Looker, traducendo domande aziendali complesse in informazioni fruibili. Formerai "spettatori" ed "esploratori" su come ottenere il massimo dalla piattaforma. Modellazione e trasformazione dei dati: progetterai e implementerai modelli dbt e data mart dimensionali, applicando le migliori pratiche di ingegneria del software (controllo della versione, test) al livello di analisi. Ingegneria della pipeline: costruirai e manterrai pipeline ETL/ELT utilizzando Airflow/Apache Composer, garantendo un'acquisizione fluida dei dati in BigQuery. Operazioni della piattaforma: monitorerai l'integrità della piattaforma dati, risolverai i problemi di qualità e implementerai la governance dei dati e i controlli di accesso. Documentazione: manterrai le definizioni e la derivazione dei dati, assicurando che Looker rimanga una "fonte unica di verità" per l'organizzazione. COME VIVRAI IL SUCCESSO CON NOI? Possiedi un master in informatica, ingegneria dei dati o un campo scientifico correlato e 3-5 anni di esperienza in ingegneria dei dati o ingegneria analitica. Hai una forte conoscenza di Looker (LookML) o PowerBI e SQL/DBT. Sai come creare dashboard sofisticati e i livelli di trasformazione che li alimentano. Hai una conoscenza approfondita di Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery) e sei esperto di SQL e Python. Hai esperienza nella creazione di pipeline con Airflow/Apache Composer. Ti piace lavorare in un ambiente frenetico, offrendo rapidamente nuove funzionalità per utenti aziendali esigenti utilizzando un modello operativo Agile/DevOps. COME TI MANTENIAMO SORRIDENTE? In un team giovane e dinamico focalizzato sullo sviluppo personale, prenderai parte al viaggio dei dati di Cartier, sfruttando strumenti all'avanguardia. Lavorerai con stakeholder multiculturali di diverse business unit per un'azienda leader nel settore del lusso. Avrai l'opportunità di fare da mentore ai membri del team man mano che la nostra maturità dei dati cresce. WIE KÖNNEN SIE EINE WIRKUNG ERZIELEN? „Der Dateningenieur bildet die Grundlage des Datenstapels und stellt sicher, dass alle Erkenntnisse in Looker durch eine robuste, skalierbare und kontrollierte Pipeline gestützt werden.“ Durch die Navigation zwischen technischer Infrastruktur und Business Intelligence haben Sie die Möglichkeit, die Datenmodelle zu entwerfen, die Geschäftsentscheidungen im gesamten Maison vorantreiben. Sie haben die Möglichkeit, Teammitglieder zu betreuen, wenn unsere Datenreife wächst. Depuis plus de 170 ans, nous adoptons un esprit audacieux et pionnier qui continue d'inspirer nos équipes dans tous les métiers, de nos boutiques à nos ateliers et bureaux d'entreprise. Nos plus de 10 000 collègues de plus de 105 nationalités sont unis par un esprit d’indépendance commun et un engagement envers l’excellence, s’efforçant d’enrichir continuellement le patrimoine de notre Maison en repoussant les limites de la créativité et de l’innovation. "Rejoignez-nous pour libérer la puissance des #data, exploiter nos plateformes cloud et déployer à grande échelle des initiatives de pointe ! Vous ferez partie d'une équipe jeune, dynamique et talentueuse travaillant sur l'analyse et l'intelligence artificielle avec des applications métiers réelles et percutantes." — Thomas M. ; Responsable des données En tant qu'ingénieur de données, vous serez responsable de la création et de la maintenance de l'infrastructure de données et de BI qui alimente nos initiatives d'analyse et de ML. Vous concevrez des pipelines de données évolutifs, garantirez la qualité des données, activerez des capacités d’analyse en libre-service et créerez des produits BI dans toute l’organisation. COMMENT ALLEZ-VOUS FAIRE UN IMPACT ? « L'ingénieur de données est à la base de la pile de données, garantissant que chaque aperçu de Looker est alimenté par un pipeline robuste, évolutif et gouverné. Naviguant entre l'infrastructure technique et la business intelligence, vous aurez l'opportunité de concevoir les modèles de données qui orientent les décisions commerciales dans l'ensemble de la Maison. VOS PRINCIPALES MISSIONS Au sein du Cartier Data Office, vous construirez des modèles de données prêts à l'emploi, une infrastructure haute performance et des tableaux de bord de reporting à grande échelle. Capacités d'analyse avec Looker : vous configurerez et gérerez les tableaux de bord et les explorations Looker, traduisant des questions commerciales complexes en informations exploitables. Vous formerez des « spectateurs » et des « explorateurs » sur la manière de tirer le meilleur parti de la plateforme. Modélisation et transformation des données : vous concevrez et mettrez en œuvre des modèles DBT et des datamarts dimensionnels, en appliquant les meilleures pratiques d'ingénierie logicielle (contrôle de version, tests) à la couche analytique. Ingénierie des pipelines : vous créerez et gérerez des pipelines ETL/ELT à l'aide d'Airflow/Apache Composer, garantissant ainsi une ingestion transparente des données dans BigQuery. Opérations de la plateforme : vous surveillerez l’état de la plateforme de données, résoudreez les problèmes de qualité et mettrez en œuvre la gouvernance des données et les contrôles d’accès. Documentation : vous maintiendrez les définitions et le traçage des données, garantissant que Looker reste une « source unique de vérité » pour l'organisation. COMMENT ALLEZ-VOUS CONNAÎTRE LE SUCCÈS AVEC NOUS ? Vous possédez une maîtrise en informatique, en ingénierie des données ou dans un domaine scientifique connexe et 3 à 5 ans d'expérience en ingénierie des données ou en ingénierie analytique. Vous avez une solide maîtrise de Looker (LookML) ou PowerBI, et SQL/DBT. Vous savez créer des tableaux de bord sophistiqués et les couches de transformation qui les alimentent. Vous avez une compréhension approfondie de Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery) et êtes expert en SQL et Python. Vous avez de l'expérience dans la création de pipelines avec Airflow/Apache Composer. jobs.description: Reference code: JR124478 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. CONTEXT Richemont, one of the world leaders in the luxury sector, has various Houses specializing in jewelry, watches and high-end accessories. Each Maison proudly embodies a tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont strives to preserve the heritage and identity specific to each of them. At the same time, we are committed to innovating and designing new products in line with the values ​​of our Houses, through a process of permanent creativity. This is a great opportunity to join an exciting team, providing core business value through data and being at the heart of our Richemont Group’s business analysis. End of Studies Internship The objective of this internship is to enrich your academic background with a stimulating professional experience in an international environment. CONTEXT A fantastic opportunity within a dynamic team awaits the right candidate. This role will suit an organized individual with a strong eye for detail, a collaborative mindset, and a keen interest in the luxury business. The successful candidate will embark on a new journey with the objective of assisting the team in the transformation of the Group into a data-driven company. As a Business Analytics Intern, you will contribute by delivering high-quality business analyses and actionable insights. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? Contribute to robust financial and business analyses, ensuring data accuracy and proactively identifying insights and trends. Translate complex business analytics into clear, concise, and visually compelling presentations for senior stakeholders. Support the preparation, update, and maintenance of monthly business performance reports. Contribute to ad hoc analyses of the Group’s business performance, addressing diverse and evolving business questions. Work closely with FP&A and analytics teams to ensure data consistency, reliability, and alignment across reporting tools. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? You are in the final year of a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Analytics, Finance, Economics, Management, or a related field. You ideally have a first experience in data analytics, preferably within finance and/or consulting. You are proficient in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint and have experience with data visualization tools (e.g. Microsoft Power BI). Knowledge of SQL and Python is a strong asset. You are highly analytical, structured, and detail-oriented, with excellent communication and interpersonal skills. You are fluent in English; proficiency in French is a plus. You are available for a 6-month internship starting in August 2026 You have a mandatory internship agreement by your university WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT? Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential. We value freedom, collegiality, loyalty, and solidarity. We foster empathy, curiosity, courage, humility, and integrity. We care for the world we live in. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US Your application will be carefully reviewed by our recruitment teams, who will give you a follow-up shortly. If your profile is selected, we will contact you for an initial phone interview. The next step will be an interview with the Manager and our HR Business Partner. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Finance Analytics Engineer Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont Talent Acquisition Europe Intern Save Amsterdam, Netherlands Richemont M&A intern Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: Reference code: JR124577 The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation. As a Software Engineer, you’ll be responsible for the end-to-end development of software solutions that connect our AI and Data Engineering capabilities with tangible business value. You’ll design scalable backend infrastructure, create functional user interfaces, and ensure secure, compliant application delivery across the organization. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? "The software engineer sits at the vital link between data capabilities and business value, ensuring that every machine learning model and data insight is operationalized into a robust, scalable, and usable application." Navigating between technical infrastructure and business needs, you will have the opportunity to design the tools and applications that drive business efficiency across the Maison. YOUR MAIN MISSIONS Within the Cartier Data Office, you will build business-ready applications, high-performance microservices, and functional internal tools. End-to-End Application Delivery: You will design and develop complete software solutions, handling both server-side logic (Python, FastAPI) and client-side interfaces (HTML, CSS, JS). API & Microservices Architecture: You will build and maintain microservices and REST APIs to expose data and ML capabilities, ensuring seamless integration within the wider ecosystem. Organizational Collaboration: You will bridge the gap between tech and business, collaborating effectively with Data Scientists and Data Engineers to operationalize machine learning models and data pipelines into production workflows. Platform Operations & DevOps: You will maintain robust deployment pipelines (CI/CD, Git) and infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform ensuring reliability and long-term maintainability. Compliance & Governance: You will ensure all software adheres to group standards, security protocols, and evolving AI regulations, proactively adapting to changing governance models. Operational Excellence: You will drive engineering efficiency by creating standardized project templates and reusable libraries to significantly accelerate Time-To-Market. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? You have a Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related scientific field and 3-5 years of experience in full-stack or backend development. You have strong proficiency in Python and backend frameworks (e.g., FastAPI), along with knowledge of standard frontend web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript). You have a deep understanding of Google Cloud Platform (Cloud Run, GKE) and modern deployment workflows (CI/CD, Containerization). You possess the ability to operate effectively within large, matrixed organizations, managing diverse stakeholders and legacy systems. You are agile and able to align with rapidly evolving internal standards, procedures, and regulatory frameworks (e.g., AI governance). You can act as a translator, streamlining the connection between the tech and the business to ensure seamless integration of our solutions within the wider ecosystem. HOW DO WE KEEP YOU SMILING? In a young and dynamic team focused on personal development, you will take part in Cartier’s tech journey, leveraging state-of-the-art tools. You will work with multicultural stakeholders from different business units for a leading Company in the luxury industry. You will have the opportunity to mentor team members as our engineering maturity grows. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US Introductory Call: If selected, we will reach out ASAP for an informal introductory call. Technical Interview: A deep dive into your Python, System Design, and software engineering skills with our Team Lead. descriptionByLocale.it: Codice di riferimento: JR124577 La storia di Cartier è fondata sulla curiosità e sulla passione. Da oltre 170 anni abbracciamo uno spirito audace e pionieristico che continua a ispirare i nostri team in tutti i settori, dalle boutique ai laboratori e agli uffici aziendali. I nostri oltre 10.000 colleghi di oltre 105 nazionalità sono uniti da uno spirito indipendente condiviso e da un impegno per l’eccellenza, sforzandosi di arricchire continuamente il patrimonio della nostra Maison spingendo i confini della creatività e dell’innovazione. In qualità di ingegnere del software, sarai responsabile dello sviluppo end-to-end di soluzioni software che collegano le nostre capacità di intelligenza artificiale e ingegneria dei dati con un valore aziendale tangibile. Progetterai un'infrastruttura backend scalabile, creerai interfacce utente funzionali e garantirai la distribuzione di applicazioni sicura e conforme in tutta l'organizzazione. COME AVRAI UN IMPATTO? "L'ingegnere del software si trova nel collegamento vitale tra le capacità dei dati e il valore aziendale, garantendo che ogni modello di machine learning e ogni intuizione dei dati siano resi operativi in ​​un'applicazione solida, scalabile e utilizzabile." Navigando tra l'infrastruttura tecnica e le esigenze aziendali, avrai l'opportunità di progettare gli strumenti e le applicazioni che promuovono l'efficienza aziendale in tutta la Maison. LE TUE MISSIONI PRINCIPALI All'interno di Cartier Data Office, creerai applicazioni pronte per il business, microservizi ad alte prestazioni e strumenti interni funzionali. Distribuzione di applicazioni end-to-end: progetterai e svilupperai soluzioni software complete, gestendo sia la logica lato server (Python, FastAPI) che le interfacce lato client (HTML, CSS, JS). Architettura API e microservizi: creerai e manterrai microservizi e API REST per esporre dati e funzionalità ML, garantendo una perfetta integrazione all'interno dell'ecosistema più ampio. Collaborazione organizzativa: colmerai il divario tra tecnologia e business, collaborando efficacemente con data scientist e data engineer per rendere operativi i modelli di machine learning e le pipeline di dati nei flussi di lavoro di produzione. Operazioni della piattaforma e DevOps: manterrai solide pipeline di distribuzione (CI/CD, Git) e un'infrastruttura su Google Cloud Platform garantendo affidabilità e manutenibilità a lungo termine. Conformità e governance: garantirai che tutto il software aderisca agli standard del gruppo, ai protocolli di sicurezza e alle normative sull'intelligenza artificiale in evoluzione, adattandoti in modo proattivo ai mutevoli modelli di governance. Eccellenza operativa: guiderai l'efficienza ingegneristica creando modelli di progetto standardizzati e librerie riutilizzabili per accelerare in modo significativo il time-to-market. COME VIVRAI IL SUCCESSO CON NOI? Possiedi un master in informatica, ingegneria del software o un campo scientifico correlato e 3-5 anni di esperienza nello sviluppo full-stack o backend. Hai una forte conoscenza di Python e dei framework backend (ad esempio FastAPI), insieme alla conoscenza delle tecnologie web frontend standard (HTML, CSS, JavaScript). Hai una conoscenza approfondita di Google Cloud Platform (Cloud Run, GKE) e dei flussi di lavoro di distribuzione moderni (CI/CD, Containerizzazione). Possiedi la capacità di operare in modo efficace all'interno di grandi organizzazioni a matrice, gestendo diverse parti interessate e sistemi legacy. Sei agile e in grado di allinearti a standard interni, procedure e quadri normativi in ​​rapida evoluzione (ad esempio, governance dell'intelligenza artificiale). Puoi agire come traduttore, ottimizzando la connessione tra la tecnologia e il business per garantire una perfetta integrazione delle nostre soluzioni all'interno dell'ecosistema più ampio. COME TI MANTENIAMO SORRIDENTE? In un team giovane e dinamico focalizzato sullo sviluppo personale, prenderai parte al viaggio tecnologico di Cartier, sfruttando strumenti all'avanguardia. Lavorerai con stakeholder multiculturali di diverse business unit per un'azienda leader nel settore del lusso. Avrai l'opportunità di fare da mentore ai membri del team man mano che la nostra maturità ingegneristica cresce. IL TUO VIAGGIO CON NOI Chiamata introduttiva: se selezionato, ti contatteremo al più presto per una chiamata introduttiva informale. Colloquio tecnico: un approfondimento sulle tue competenze in Python, progettazione di sistemi e ingegneria del software con il nostro team leader. Seit mehr als 170 Jahren leben wir einen mutigen Pioniergeist, der unsere Teams in allen Metiers, von unseren Boutiquen bis hin zu unseren Werkstätten und Unternehmensbüros, weiterhin inspiriert. Als Software Engineer sind Sie für die End-to-End-Entwicklung von Softwarelösungen verantwortlich, die unsere KI- und Data-Engineering-Fähigkeiten mit einem konkreten Geschäftswert verbinden. Sie entwerfen eine skalierbare Backend-Infrastruktur, erstellen funktionale Benutzeroberflächen und sorgen für eine sichere, konforme Anwendungsbereitstellung im gesamten Unternehmen. WIE KÖNNEN SIE EINE WIRKUNG ERZIELEN? „Der Softwareentwickler ist das entscheidende Bindeglied zwischen Datenfähigkeiten und Geschäftswert und stellt sicher, dass jedes maschinelle Lernmodell und jede Datenerkenntnis in einer robusten, skalierbaren und nutzbaren Anwendung umgesetzt wird.“ Indem Sie zwischen technischer Infrastruktur und Geschäftsanforderungen navigieren, haben Sie die Möglichkeit, die Tools und Anwendungen zu entwerfen, die die Geschäftseffizienz im gesamten Maison steigern. IHRE HAUPTAUFGABEN Im Cartier Data Office erstellen Sie geschäftsfähige Anwendungen, leistungsstarke Microservices und funktionale interne Tools. End-to-End-Anwendungsbereitstellung: Sie entwerfen und entwickeln komplette Softwarelösungen und verwalten dabei sowohl serverseitige Logik (Python, FastAPI) als auch clientseitige Schnittstellen (HTML, CSS, JS). API- und Microservices-Architektur: Sie erstellen und pflegen Microservices und REST-APIs, um Daten- und ML-Funktionen bereitzustellen und eine nahtlose Integration in das breitere Ökosystem sicherzustellen. Organisatorische Zusammenarbeit: Sie schließen die Lücke zwischen Technologie und Wirtschaft und arbeiten effektiv mit Datenwissenschaftlern und Dateningenieuren zusammen, um Modelle für maschinelles Lernen und Datenpipelines in Produktionsabläufe zu implementieren. Plattformbetrieb und DevOps: Sie pflegen robuste Bereitstellungspipelines (CI/CD, Git) und Infrastruktur auf der Google Cloud Platform, um Zuverlässigkeit und langfristige Wartbarkeit sicherzustellen. Operative Exzellenz: Sie steigern die technische Effizienz durch die Erstellung standardisierter Projektvorlagen und wiederverwendbarer Bibliotheken, um die Time-to-Market deutlich zu verkürzen. WIE ERLEBEN SIE MIT UNS ERFOLGREICH? Sie haben einen Master-Abschluss in Informatik, Software Engineering oder einem verwandten wissenschaftlichen Bereich und 3–5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Full-Stack- oder Backend-Entwicklung. Sie verfügen über fundierte Kenntnisse in Python und Backend-Frameworks (z. B. FastAPI) sowie über Kenntnisse in Standard-Frontend-Webtechnologien (HTML, CSS, JavaScript). Sie verfügen über ein tiefes Verständnis der Google Cloud Platform (Cloud Run, GKE) und moderner Bereitstellungsworkflows (CI/CD, Containerisierung). Sie verfügen über die Fähigkeit, in großen, strukturierten Organisationen effektiv zu agieren und verschiedene Interessengruppen und Altsysteme zu verwalten. Sie sind agil und in der Lage, sich an sich schnell entwickelnde interne Standards, Verfahren und regulatorische Rahmenbedingungen (z. B. KI-Governance) anzupassen. Sie können als Übersetzer fungieren und die Verbindung zwischen Technologie und Geschäft optimieren, um eine nahtlose Integration unserer Lösungen in das breitere Ökosystem sicherzustellen. Wie sorgen wir dafür, dass Sie lächeln? En tant qu'ingénieur logiciel, vous serez responsable du développement de bout en bout de solutions logicielles qui relient nos capacités d'IA et d'ingénierie des données à une valeur commerciale tangible. Vous concevrez une infrastructure backend évolutive, créerez des interfaces utilisateur fonctionnelles et garantirez une livraison d’applications sécurisée et conforme dans toute l’organisation. COMMENT ALLEZ-VOUS AVOIR UN IMPACT ? « L'ingénieur logiciel se situe au lien vital entre les capacités des données et la valeur commerciale, garantissant que chaque modèle d'apprentissage automatique et chaque aperçu des données sont opérationnalisés dans une application robuste, évolutive et utilisable. En naviguant entre l'infrastructure technique et les besoins commerciaux, vous aurez l'opportunité de concevoir les outils et les applications qui améliorent l'efficacité commerciale dans l'ensemble de la Maison. VOS PRINCIPALES MISSIONS Au sein du Cartier Data Office, vous construirez des applications métiers, des microservices performants et des outils internes fonctionnels. Livraison d'applications de bout en bout : vous concevrez et développerez des solutions logicielles complètes, gérant à la fois la logique côté serveur (Python, FastAPI) et les interfaces côté client (HTML, CSS, JS). Architecture API et microservices : vous créerez et maintiendrez des microservices et des API REST pour exposer les données et les capacités de ML, garantissant ainsi une intégration transparente dans l'écosystème plus large. Collaboration organisationnelle : vous comblerez le fossé entre la technologie et les affaires, en collaborant efficacement avec les data scientists et les ingénieurs de données pour opérationnaliser les modèles d'apprentissage automatique et les pipelines de données dans les flux de travail de production. Opérations de plate-forme et DevOps : vous maintiendrez des pipelines de déploiement (CI/CD, Git) et une infrastructure robustes sur Google Cloud Platform, garantissant la fiabilité et la maintenabilité à long terme. Conformité et gouvernance : vous veillerez à ce que tous les logiciels respectent les normes du groupe, les protocoles de sécurité et l'évolution des réglementations en matière d'IA, en vous adaptant de manière proactive aux modèles de gouvernance changeants. Excellence opérationnelle : vous améliorerez l'efficacité de l'ingénierie en créant des modèles de projet standardisés et des bibliothèques réutilisables pour accélérer considérablement la mise sur le marché. COMMENT ALLEZ-VOUS CONNAÎTRE LE SUCCÈS AVEC NOUS ? Vous possédez une maîtrise en informatique, en génie logiciel ou dans un domaine scientifique connexe et 3 à 5 ans d'expérience en développement full-stack ou backend. Vous possédez une solide maîtrise de Python et des frameworks backend (par exemple, FastAPI), ainsi qu'une connaissance des technologies Web frontend standards (HTML, CSS, JavaScript). Vous avez une compréhension approfondie de Google Cloud Platform (Cloud Run, GKE) et des workflows de déploiement modernes (CI/CD, conteneurisation). Vous possédez la capacité d'opérer efficacement au sein de grandes organisations matricielles, en gérant diverses parties prenantes et des systèmes existants. Vous êtes agile et capable de vous aligner sur les normes, procédures et cadres réglementaires internes en évolution rapide (par exemple, la gouvernance de l'IA). Vous pouvez agir en tant que traducteur, rationalisant la connexion entre la technologie et l'entreprise pour assurer une intégration transparente de nos solutions dans l'écosystème plus large. COMMENT POUVONS-NOUS VOUS GARDER LE SOURIRE ? Au sein d’une équipe jeune et dynamique axée sur le développement personnel, vous participerez au parcours technologique de Cartier, en tirant parti d’outils de pointe. Vous travaillerez avec des acteurs multiculturels de différentes unités commerciales pour une entreprise leader de l'industrie du luxe. Vous aurez l'occasion d'encadrer les membres de l'équipe à mesure que notre maturité en ingénierie grandit. VOTRE VOYAGE AVEC NOUS Appel de présentation : Si vous êtes sélectionné, nous vous contacterons dès que possible pour un appel de présentation informel. Entretien technique : une plongée approfondie dans vos compétences en Python, en conception de systèmes et en ingénierie logicielle avec notre chef d'équipe. Codice di riferimento: JR124656 La storia di Cartier si basa su curiosità e passione. Da oltre 170 anni abbracciamo uno spirito audace e pionieristico che continua a ispirare i nostri team in tutti i Métiers, dalle boutique ai laboratori e agli uffici aziendali. I nostri oltre 10.000 colleghi di più di 105 nazionalità sono uniti da uno spirito indipendente condiviso e dall’impegno per l’eccellenza, cercando di arricchire continuamente il patrimonio della nostra Maison spingendo i limiti della creatività e dell’innovazione. QUAL È IL TUO IMPATTO MISSIONE Nel nostro dipartimento di Sviluppo, cerchiamo un/una Progettista-Gioielliere per definire e progettare i prodotti finiti, tenendo conto delle restrizioni tecnologiche, estetiche, di budget e di qualità. RESPONSABILITÀ Sei incaricato di redigere un capitolato tecnico integrando i criteri di ergonomia, integrità e riparabilità di un gioiello espressi dalla Creazione, dall’esperto gioielliere e dal servizio clienti. Trascrivi le esigenze della Creazione (gouache) in un volume CAD 3D secondo gli standard della Maison Cartier. Sei garante della fattibilità durante la progettazione del prodotto in collaborazione con i tecnici di metodi.
• Presenti i prototipi in resina per la validazione del concetto da parte della Creazione.
• Garantisci la conformità del prototipo fisico (oro/platino) prima della validazione da parte della Creazione.
• Presenti il prototipo fisico alla Creazione e argomenta le scelte tecniche se necessario. Realizzi il dossier tecnico completo comprendente i volumi 3D (seguendo la metodologia di disegno della Maison Cartier), le tavole di progetto e le catene di quote che garantiscono il rispetto del capitolato, nonché le distinte base dei prodotti (dossier di catena di quote con 2D/3D) in collaborazione con i reparti di metodi e qualità. Fornisci i dati necessari alla creazione delle referenze prodotto nel PLM. Partecipa alla affidabilità e al miglioramento continuo dei prodotti. COSA CERCHIAMO Diploma di laurea in ingegneria in microtecnica, meccanica, progettazione ergonomica e design o equivalente, con almeno 3 anni di esperienza confermata in un ruolo simile, preferibilmente in un ambiente industriale. Sei a tuo agio con la CAO, idealmente su CREO, e hai una buona padronanza dell’analisi funzionale e delle catene di quote. Possiedi solide conoscenze in assemblaggi tecnici, integrando le restrizioni di fattibilità industriale tramite lavorazioni meccaniche. Grazie al tuo senso delle priorità, sei in grado di gestire progetti di grande portata e di lavorare in completa autonomia. Le tue competenze comunicative ti permettono di presentare e difendere i tuoi progetti con facilità durante le riunioni. Grazie alla tua flessibilità, rigore e capacità di instaurare relazioni, intrattieni scambi proficui con le diverse interfacce. LA TUA ESPERIENZA CON NOI Il nostro team HR è a tua disposizione, secondo le tue preferenze e necessità, durante tutto il percorso di selezione. Man mano che avanzi nel processo di reclutamento, incontrerai il nostro HR Business Partner e il/la Responsabile della posizione, e parteciperai a studi di caso o valutazioni in base alle esigenze del ruolo. Scrivi il prossimo capitolo della tua storia con Cartier. Reference code: JR124656 The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation. WHAT WILL BE YOUR IMPACT
• MISSION
• Within our Development department, we are looking for a Jewelry Designer to define and design finished products, taking into account technological, aesthetic, budgetary, and quality constraints. RESPONSIBILITIES You are responsible for creating a specifications document that incorporates ergonomic, integrity, and reparability criteria of a jewelry piece expressed by the Creation, the jewelry expert, and the customer service.
• You transcribe the Creation’s needs (gouache) into a 3D CAD volume following the Maison Cartier standards.
• You ensure the feasibility during product design in collaboration with methods technicians.
• You present resin prototypes for concept validation by the Creation.
• You guarantee the conformity of the physical prototype (gold/platinum) before validation by the Creation.
• You present the physical prototype to the Creation and argue technical choices if necessary. You produce the complete technical dossier including 3D volumes (following Cartier’s drawing methodology), drawings, dimension chains ensuring the requirements in the specifications, and product bills of materials (2D/3D dimension chain dossier) in collaboration with methods and quality. You provide data necessary for creating product references in the PLM. You participate in the reliability and continuous improvement of products. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR Holder of an engineering degree in microtechnology, mechanics, ergonomic design, or equivalent, with confirmed experience of at least 3 years in a similar role, ideally within an industrial environment.
• You are comfortable with CAD, ideally CREO, and have a good understanding of functional analysis and dimension chains.
• You possess solid knowledge of technical assemblies, integrating industrial feasibility constraints through machining.
• Thanks to your prioritization skills, you can manage large-scale projects and work independently.
• Your communication skills allow you to present and defend your projects confidently during meetings.
• Thanks to your flexibility, rigor, and relationship-building skills, you maintain fruitful exchanges with various interfaces. YOUR EXPERIENCE WITH US
• Our HR team is available to listen to your needs and preferences throughout your experience with our Maison.
• As you progress through our recruitment process, you will meet our HR Business Partner and the Hiring Manager, and participate in case studies or assessments as needed. Write the next chapter of your story with Cartier. Über 10.000 Kollegen aus mehr als 105 Nationen sind durch einen gemeinsamen unabhängigen Geist und das Streben nach Exzellenz vereint, wobei wir kontinuierlich das Erbe unseres Hauses bereichern, indem wir die Grenzen von Kreativität und Innovation verschieben. Sie übertragen die Bedürfnisse der Kreation (Gouache) in ein 3D-CAD-Volumen nach den Standards der Maison Cartier. Sie sind Garant für die Machbarkeit während der Produktentwicklung in Zusammenarbeit mit den Methoden-Technikern. Sie präsentieren Resin-Prototypen zur Konzeptvalidierung durch die Kreation. Sie gewährleisten die Konformität des physischen Prototyps (Gold/Platin) vor der Validierung durch die Kreation. Sie präsentieren den physischen Prototyp der Kreation und argumentieren technische Entscheidungen bei Bedarf. Sie erstellen das vollständige technische Dossier, einschließlich 3D-Volumen (nach der Zeichnungsmethodik der Maison Cartier), Zeichnungen, Maßketten, die die
• Anforderungen des Lastenhefts erfüllen, sowie Stücklisten der Produkte (Dossier mit 2D/3D-Maßkette) in Zusammenarbeit mit den Methoden- und Qualitätsabteilungen. Sie liefern die Daten, die für die Erstellung von Produktreferenzen im PLM notwendig sind. Sie tragen zur Zuverlässigkeit und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Produkte bei. WAS WIR SUCHEN Träger eines Ingenieurabschlusses in Mikrotechnik, Mechanik, ergonomischem Design oder Ähnlichem, mit mindestens 3 Jahren nachweislicher Erfahrung in einer ähnlichen Position, idealerweise in einem industriellen Umfeld. Sie sind sicher im Umgang mit CAD, idealerweise CREO, und verfügen über ein gutes Verständnis für funktionale Analyse und Maßketten. Sie besitzen fundierte Kenntnisse in technischen Montagen, die die Machbarkeitsbeschränkungen durch Bearbeitung integrieren. Dank Ihrer Priorisierungsfähigkeiten können Sie große Projekte eigenständig managen. Ihre Kommunikationsfähigkeiten ermöglichen es Ihnen, Ihre Projekte sicher zu präsentieren und zu verteidigen. Dank Ihrer Flexibilität, Strenge und Fähigkeit, Beziehungen aufzubauen, pflegen Sie erfolgreiche Austausch mit verschiedenen Schnittstellen. IHRE ERFAHRUNG BEI UNS Unser HR-Team steht Ihnen jederzeit zur Verfügung, um Ihre Bedürfnisse und Wünsche während Ihrer gesamten Erfahrung bei unserem Haus zu hören. Im Verlauf unseres Rekrutierungsprozesses treffen Sie unseren HR Business Partner und den/ die Verantwortliche/n der Position und nehmen an Fallstudien oder Bewertungen teil, je nach Bedarf. Schreiben Sie das nächste Kapitel Ihrer Geschichte mit Cartier. jobs.title: Logistics Manufacturing Tech Team Lead
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR124697 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. “Join a dynamic Technology and Business environment to help our Manufactures transition into Industry 4.0 tools and practices” CONTEXT Our Manufactures have embarked into a journey with Industry 4.0 to accelerate digitalization and support more connected operational use cases bringing more efficiency and quality, based on latest technologies for Industrial IoT, Automation, No/Low Coding platforms and Analytics. The scope of our manufacturing operations covers 30+ sites in Europe on which 20+ in Switzerland and various business activities mainly based on watchmaking & jewellery, from traditional to more industrialized practices. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? The role is embedded in Richemont’s Group Technology Product Domain “Operations & Services” and part of the Manufacturing Product Area. As a Logistic Manufacturing Tech Team Lead, you and your team will be responsible for the analysis, design, deployment and support of the different components of our Logistic Manufacturing Applications Architecture. You will be accountable for the improvements and delivery of the applications according to the roadmap of our “Product Owner” and guidelines of our Architects. Our scope of Logistic Manufacturing includes all business processes of the value chain related to Logistic such as Inbound/Outbound process, inventory management, production integration. This scope is covered by SAP EWM used as a back-End Warehouse Management System, which is exposed to various Logistic Execution Front-End. This decoupling strategy is supported within a modern landscape based on APIs and Event Driven Architecture. Key 
• Responsibilities: Define a technical Vision and maintain the roadmap in alignment with product strategy and enterprise architecture. In charge of managing a Technology Team of experienced Consultants in designing, deploying and supporting our solutions for our Manufactures, according to our Agile practices Lead, Develop and motivate your Team to propose the best solutions and continuously learn new skills and technologies Ensure compliance with architecture and security guardrails. Prepare Budget and plan your team capacity to support all the initiatives requested by our Maisons Liaise and be the key contact to integrate with other teams on all integration topics HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCESS WITH US? Master degree / Engineer 7+ years of experience, ideally with a consulting background, in contact with industrial environments in Logistic as well in IT Strong Experience in full Projects lifecycle deploying Manufacturing ERP & WMS from Design to Run Collaborative leadership and coaching mindset. Experience in designing business solutions based on SAP ERP & EWM, with MES related experiences, ideally also with Low Code / No Code platforms Good understanding of architecture design principles and integration technologies such as APIs Good understanding of software development & customizing lifecycle in Agile and Scrum models Experience in Team Management overseeing the Design, Deployment and Support activities, including budget follow up and planning activities Excellent ability and experience to effectively communicate technical information to management, peers and industry partners. Fluent in French and English HOW DO WE KEEP YOU SMILING? The role is a perfect mix between designing, building and maintaining new solutions while developing and leading an experienced agile team at the service of all our Maisons’ Manufactures The variety and density of initiatives with our Maisons provides a great portfolio of opportunities to always learn and develop new skills At Richemont we can and do discuss with all levels of technology and business, and your value-added and advice is highly appreciated by the business stakeholders. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US: 1. If your application is selected, we will reach out to you ASAP for an informal introductory call. 2. The next step from there would be a first Technical interview with the Manufacturing Product Area Manager and if there is a match, you will have a personal meeting with him/her and our HR Business Partner. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Digital Manufacturing Tech Team Lead Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont Manufacturing Processes Definition & Integration Tech Team Lead Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont Manufacturing Controlling Tech Team Lead Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont

descriptionByLocale.it: Codice di riferimento: JR124697 Richemont possiede alcune delle più importanti Maison di beni di lusso al mondo, con punti di forza particolari in gioielleria, orologi di alta gamma e accessori di lusso. Ogni Maison rappresenta una tradizione orgogliosa di stile, qualità e artigianato e Richemont si impegna a preservare il patrimonio e l’identità di ciascuna di esse. Allo stesso tempo, siamo impegnati nell’innovazione e nella progettazione di nuovi prodotti che siano in linea con i valori delle nostre Maisons, attraverso un processo di creatività continua. "Unisciti a un ambiente dinamico di Tecnologia e Business per aiutare le nostre Manifatture a passare a strumenti e pratiche Industry 4.0" CONTEXT Le nostre Manifatture hanno intrapreso un percorso con Industry 4.0 per accelerare la digitalizzazione e supportare casi d’uso operativi più connessi, portando maggiore efficienza e qualità, basandosi sulle ultime tecnologie per Industrial IoT, Automazione, piattaforme No/Low Coding e Analytics. L’ambito delle nostre operazioni di produzione copre oltre 30 siti in Europa, di cui più di 20 in Svizzera, con attività principalmente legate all’orologeria e alla gioielleria, dal metodo tradizionale a pratiche più industrializzate. COME AVRAI IMPATTO? Il ruolo è inserito nel Dominio di Prodotto Tecnologico del Gruppo Richemont "Operations & Services" e fa parte dell’Area di Prodotto Manufacturing. Come Responsabile Tecnico del Team Manufacturing Logistico, tu e il tuo team sarete responsabili dell’analisi, progettazione, implementazione e supporto dei diversi componenti dell’Architettura delle Applicazioni di Manufacturing Logistico. Sarai responsabile dei miglioramenti e della consegna delle applicazioni secondo la roadmap del nostro “Product Owner” e le linee guida dei nostri Architetti. Il nostro ambito di Manufacturing Logistico include tutti i processi aziendali della catena del valore legati alla Logistica, come i processi Inbound/Outbound, gestione dell’inventario, integrazione della produzione. Questo ambito è coperto da SAP EWM, utilizzato come sistema di gestione magazzino back-end, esposto a vari front-end di esecuzione logistica. Questa strategia di decoupling è supportata in un panorama moderno basato su API e Architettura Event-Driven. IL TUO VIAGGIO CON NOI: 1. Se la tua candidatura sarà selezionata, ti contatteremo al più presto per una chiamata introduttiva informale. 2. Il passo successivo sarà un primo colloquio tecnico con il Responsabile dell’Area di Prodotto Manufacturing e, se ci sarà una corrispondenza, avrai un incontro personale con lui/lei e il nostro HR Business Partner. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Jobs simili: Manufacturing Controlling Tech Team Lead Salva Meyrin, Svizzera Richemont Digital Manufacturing Tech Team Lead Salva Meyrin, Svizzera Richemont Definizione e Integrazione dei Processi di Manufacturing Tech Team Lead Salva Meyrin, Svizzera Richemont
